raw_segments.text: Soon after 5 p.m., we had another meal, consisting of a small mug of coffee and half a slice
I devoured my bread and drank my coffee with relish, but I should have been glad of as
much more, I was still hungry.
Half an hour's recreation succeeded, then study, then the glass of water and the piece
of oat cake, prayers and bed.
Such was my first day at Lode.
